name: Dating Life: Miley X Emily
source: This game is a story about two characters and what would happen after a chance encounter... The two women Emily and Miley end up on a date after Miley inputs her details incorrectly in a new dating App. Whilst neither of them might have chosen this date they both decide to just go with it. From then on your choices as Miley will determine what will happen as a result of this unexpected date.
